laws.rule: Akita Prefecture's anti-littering ordinance bans dropping cans, PET bottles, plastic bags and cigarette butts, and leaving dog droppings. The prefecture asks smokers to use designated smoking spots or a portable ashtray. Its page states no fine.
laws.heading: 秋田県空き缶等の散乱の防止に関する条例

laws.rule: Akita Ordinance on Healthy Development of Young People and a Cleaner Environment (秋田県青少年の健全育成と環境浄化に関する条例), art. 16. The ordinance sets the late-night period as 11 pm to sunrise. A guardian must try not to let a young person (generally under 18) go out in that period without special reason; the guardian's own duty has no penalty. Anyone else is barred from taking such a young person out, going about with them or keeping them out in that period without the guardian's consent or another proper reason. The offence for others carries a fine of up to JPY 100,000 (about A$902). Rates: RBA 30 Oct 2026, A$1 = JPY 110.82.
